Proposition
[Covering space actions give normal covering spaces]

↗ def:group-action ↗ def:orbit-space ↗ prop:normal-covering-deck-group ↗ prop:covering-unique-lifting 1. ch1:1.40\group Covering Spaces

If $G$ acts on $Y$ as a covering space action, then $Y\to Y/G$ is normal, $G(Y)\cong G$ when $Y$ is path-connected, and, when $Y$ is locally path-connected, $G\cong \pi _1(Y/G)/p_*\pi _1(Y)$.

Proof

\sketch The translates of a neighborhood satisfying the action condition are disjoint sheets over its image, proving the covering and normality. A deck transformation agrees with the unique group element carrying one chosen point to its image. The quotient formula follows from section 3.

□
